text: つよさは　むげん　なのね　おしえて　くれて　ありがとう

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form means someone did the thing for me; in its own て-form before ありがとう it says what the thanks are for. おしえて　くれて　ありがとう = 'thank you for teaching me'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なの is the soft, feminine form of なのだ and shows the speaker has just understood something; ね adds 'isn't it'. むげん　なのね = 'so it's limitless, isn't it'.
